description: Renovate opens a pull request for each new release of anything pinned here, which the owner merges (R5). The shared preset applies (zindello-cluster/cluster-platform: renovate/preset.json); this file holds only what's particular to this repo.

customManagers.description: CoreScope's release in corescope/Dockerfile's ARG RELEASE_TAG: the release of the FROM line's image, without its -bxmesh suffix, read from the same image's tags so it moves with the FROM line (the entrypoint's pre-upgrade backup and rollback key on it).

packageRules.description: BXMesh's CoreScope image (github.com/bxmesh/corescope), the FROM line and RELEASE_TAG together, in one pull request. The shared preset turns off every ghcr.io/bxmesh/** image, since CI writes their tags; this one is built by the fork and pinned here by hand, so Renovate opens its bumps (the owner, 27 November 2026).
The FROM line: only the fork's release tags (vX.Y.Z-bxmesh), never its sha- tags.
RELEASE_TAG is a plain version, with no digest to pin: the FROM line carries the digest.
